case.summary: Customer C13171 disputed a $55.68 online transaction (Ref. 3558054), prompting an investigation that evaluated the customer's high device turnover (182 distinct devices) alongside an assessed 0.85 probability of card-not-present fraud. Although the flagged transaction's device fingerprint was non-diagnostic and shared across many users, the verified customer report and risk pattern strongly supported unauthorized activity. Consequently, per the bank's fraud mitigation policies, the recommended actions are to block the affected card and open a formal case (Rules: BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE).
